title: IntegBranchEnvelopes
description: Machine-readable Swarm Delivery Law path envelopes: durable integ/<root> and integ/{docs,specs} branches, hub sole-owner list, adjunct claim rules, and concurrent-safe exemption pointers. Owned by integ/specs (ADR-0711 D-8).

_meta.purpose: Policy-as-data for envelope containment, hub exclusivity, concurrent-safe exemptions, tools/swarm adjunct ownership, and hyperscaler monorepo pattern notes under the Swarm Delivery Law.

tools.note: Transitional root under Amendment B reorg-target debt freeze. tools/swarm/** one-shot process-kit land via integ/specs (#1644) is the sole authorized birth wave; after that merge, tools/ is shrink-only — further births require an explicit reorg-move-out bead to a durable home.

active_waivers.reason: Index ADR-0711 in the same bootstrap PR that introduces the ADR and envelopes (sole-owner hub waiver).
Absorb #1628+#1629 leaf residuals: files_scanned freeze coupled to lifecycle-config deletions on integ/specs (ADR-0711 dual-trunk closeout).

adjunct_claims.description: A unit may touch paths outside envelope(R) only when an explicit adjunct claim is recorded for this wave. Claims are fail-closed: absent claim = refuse.
rules: Adjunct leaves must be disjoint from every other open integ PR's claimed set.
Hub paths are never adjuncts — they use hub waivers only.
Concurrent-safe exemption paths do not require adjunct claims when the edit is append-only under the registered exemption.
Cargo.lock may travel only with the integ that changed workspace membership (hub rule), never as a silent adjunct.

active.reason: Bootstrap Swarm Delivery Law Phase A: land tools/swarm shims with the envelopes owner before a dedicated integ/tools wave; tools root registered in this same diff.
deliver.js Claim/Land harness is the primary consumer of envelopes; co-land with policy-as-data on integ/specs.
Portable Swarm Contract is concurrent-safe evidence for the delivery-fabric program and travels with the law bootstrap.
Single PR preference: ADR-0711 co-lands with envelopes self-owner rather than splitting integ/docs for this bootstrap wave.
Register .beads/** and evidence/** concurrent-safe exemptions required by ADR-0711 D-2 in the same wave as envelopes.
Bootstrap hub-waiver directory for Phase A; gate check lands later under integ/governance.
Ignore .check/ daemon machine output colocated with tools/swarm check-daemon.

required_steps: verify unit diff is subset of envelope(R) + claimed adjuncts + waivered hubs
verify hub exclusivity against open PRs

concurrent_safe_exemptions.note: Exemptions reduce path-overlap refusal for append-only / per-lane evidence. They do not authorize envelope escape for product code.

hyperscaler_monorepo_patterns.note: First-class hyperscaler / clean-architecture monorepo rules — not agent-swarm folklore alone. Envelopes, hubs, and worker discipline must stay consistent with these patterns.
cites: ADR-0119 (flat cross-cutting specs/ hub; product colocation via ADR-0131 amendment)
ADR-0131 (service colocation + product-owned specs; superseded as live apex by ADR-0701)

docs_specs_planes.rule: planes integ/docs and integ/specs own only cross-cutting hubs and indexes; capability product docs/specs colocate under the owning root and travel with that integ/<root>
docs_specs_planes.anti_pattern: do not create docs/<root> or specs/<root> mirror dumps for product artifacts — that is dual-home debt

one_shot_exceptions.reason: Phase A Swarm Delivery Law process-kit land; after merge tools/ is shrink-only.

historical_never_repeat.note: allow-new for cloud-os/libs was a one-shot disjoint drain — NEVER REPEAT

reorg_target_debt_freeze.claim_exemption_rule: New path births under frozen_prefixes are refused by deliver.js Claim unless the claimed bead title or body contains the marker reorg-move-out naming the durable destination.
enforcement: human/reviewer refuse of births under frozen prefixes without reorg-move-out bead
